title: Survived By
deck: A painted one-sheet for an independent film.
lede: For K.D. Chalk's “Survived By,” the one-sheet is a single illustrated figure: a woman in pink, holding a record.
challenge: “Survived By,” directed by K.D. Chalk in Los Angeles, needed a poster that could stand for the whole film in one image.
work: The one-sheet rests on a single figure, painted in loose strokes: a woman in pink, holding a record close, against a pale ground. One figure, one object and the title above them. Nothing on the poster competes with her.
system: A woman in pink, holding a record.
Pale and open, so she carries the poster.
credits: Dalton Corr: poster design and illustration
